provenance.text: 100% synthetic, LLM-generated by Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google). Individual uploader, no paper, no code, no generation script in the repo.

quotes.quote: High-quality synthetic dataset for training function-calling / tool-use capabilities in LLMs.

- **9723 examples** across 6 domains
- **30 unique function definitions** with JSON Schema parameters
- **5 complexity levels**: simple, moderate, complex, multi-tool, conversational
- Generated using Gemini 2.0 Flash with careful prompt engineering and validation

upstream_sources.name: none declared
upstream_sources.detail: 6 invented domains (E-commerce, Calendar, DevOps, Finance, CRM, Data Analysis) x 5 functions each.

generation_models.provider: Google (Gemini API / AI Studio / Vertex - which one is not stated)
generation_models.note: Gemini API terms prohibit using the Services to develop competing models; that restriction binds the API customer (the dataset author), and its effect on downstream users of an Apache-2.0-labelled dataset is a legal question for the lead.

contamination_notes: Card says nothing about BFCL / ToolACE / xlam / Glaive or any benchmark. Function set is 30 custom synthetic functions (search_products, get_product_details, add_to_cart, apply_coupon, checkout, ...) - no evidence of derivation from BFCL/ToolACE. Not verifiable beyond the 100 sampled rows.

schema.name: messages
schema.meaning: OpenAI-legacy style chat: system (lists available functions as "- name: description" bullet text), user, assistant with content=null and function_call={name, arguments(JSON string)}. Card says function results may also appear.

schema.name: metadata.domain
schema.meaning: Domain tag. Only "ecommerce" observed (all first 100 rows). Card lists 6 domains: E-commerce, Calendar, DevOps, Finance, CRM, Data Analysis - exact string values for the other five not observed.

schema.name: metadata.complexity
schema.meaning: Complexity tag. Only "simple" observed (all first 100 rows). Card lists: simple, moderate, complex, multi-tool, conversational.

schema.name: metadata.functions_available
schema.meaning: names of the candidate functions for the example (5 per domain) = the natural candidate set for ranking.

example_row_summary:
row 0: system="You are a helpful assistant with access to the following functions. Use them when needed to help the user.

Available functions:
- search_products: Search for products in the catalog
- get_product_details: ...
- add_to_cart: ...
- apply_coupon: ...
- checkout: ..."; user="Can you search for some comfy slippers?"; assistant={content:null, function_call:{name:"search_products", arguments:"{"query": "comfy slippers"}"}}; metadata={domain:"ecommerce", complexity:"simple", functions_available:[5 names]}.

All first 100 rows: domain=ecommerce, complexity=simple, exactly 3 messages (system,user,assistant). The system prompt in sampled rows gives only name + one-line description - the "JSON Schema parameters" claimed by the card are NOT present in the sampled rows.
surprises: Claims check: ~9.7k -> 9,723 rows CONFIRMED; Apache-2.0 CONFIRMED as declared (card says "use for any purpose including commercial training").
Card metadata size_categories says 10K<n<100K but the dataset has 9,723 rows.
Generated with Gemini 2.0 Flash: Google Gemini API terms contain a no-competing-models clause (quoted in license_quotes).
Only 30 distinct functions / 6 domains -> very low tool diversity; first 100 rows are near-templated single-call e-commerce queries.
Anonymous individual uploader, no paper/code/validation evidence; "validation" is claimed but not described.
unverified: Which Google service/terms the author used (Gemini API free/paid tier vs Vertex AI) - affects which provider terms apply.
Whether JSON Schema parameter definitions appear anywhere in the data (not in sampled rows).
Distribution over domains/complexity; presence of multi-turn / function-result messages; correctness of the function-call labels.
Any overlap with BFCL/ToolACE test items.

audit_meta.method: Hub API + raw card + tree listing + datasets-server info/splits/size/first-rows + linked papers/GitHub; NO data files downloaded; machine not logged in to HF
